configurations.name: stream-tts
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; os.environ.setdefault('STREAM_TTS_PORT', '8092'); os.environ.setdefault('STREAM_TTS_DATA', 'stream-tts-data/native'); sys.path.insert(0, 'stream-tts'); import runpy; runpy.run_module('streamtts', run_name='__main__')

configurations.name: stream-tts-en
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; os.environ.update(STREAM_TTS_PORT='8093', STREAM_TTS_LANG='en', STREAM_TTS_DATA='stream-tts-data/en-test', STREAM_TTS_MODELS='stream-tts-data/en-test/models', STREAM_TTS_VOICES='stream-tts-data/en-test/voices'); sys.path.insert(0, 'stream-tts'); import runpy; runpy.run_module('streamtts', run_name='__main__')

configurations.name: stream-tts-espeech-dl
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; d='stream-tts-data/espeech-dl/'; os.environ.update(STREAM_TTS_PORT='8097', STREAM_TTS_DATA=d+'data', STREAM_TTS_MODELS=d+'models', STREAM_TTS_VOICES=d+'voices', STREAM_TTS_RUNTIME=d+'rt', ESPEECH_RUNTIME=d+'espeech-runtime'); sys.path.insert(0, 'stream-tts'); import runpy; runpy.run_module('streamtts', run_name='__main__')

configurations.name: streamtts-exe-test
runtimeArgs: import os, subprocess; d=os.path.abspath('stream-tts-data/exe-test')+os.sep; os.environ.update(STREAM_TTS_PORT='8098', STREAM_TTS_DATA=d+'data', STREAM_TTS_MODELS=d+'models', STREAM_TTS_VOICES=d+'voices'); subprocess.run([os.path.abspath('packaging/windows/dist/StreamTTS/StreamTTS.exe'), '--no-browser'])
